svg.title: Sender app languages on a world map
svg.desc: World map. Countries are shaded by the number of Telegram senders whose app language is mainly spoken there; the Arabic-speaking countries are hatched as one region with 134,755 senders. Largest placed values: Persian 1,447, Burmese 784, Chinese 529, Uzbek 499, Turkish 498, Brazilian Portuguese 374, German 361, Indonesian 347, Najdi Arabic 292.

g.text: Where the senders' app languages are spoken
language_code of human senders. A country is shaded when a language is mainly spoken there. App setting, not location.
too many countries to place. Activity peaks at 21:00 UTC+3.
Not placeable, spoken in too many countries: en 38,654, fr 5,221, ru 3,791, es 1,244.
Placed on the map: 6,637 senders in 69 languages. No language_code at all: 146,142 senders.
fa is drawn on Iran and Afghanistan, de on Germany, Austria and Switzerland, zh on China and Taiwan; values are not split.
Source: raw webhook logs, last from.language_code per sender, 40 days. Borders: Natural Earth 1:110m (public domain).
